skill.summary: Implement Chatbot Personality Set using OrbCafe UI (CustomizeAgent). Enterprise-grade React component with built-in best practices.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Chatbot Personality Set skill using OrbCafe UI.
- Provides an enterprise-grade React component (CustomizeAgent) for configuring chatbot personality.
- Features standardized UI, i18n, theming, accessibility, and TypeScript support out-of-the-box.
- Includes installation instructions and a basic usage example.
